confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregator snippets (Expatica/Numbeo-style, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, GlobalCostData, Gotripzi) and are cross-checked against each other, so they are reasonable bounded estimates rather than verified menu prices. Cocktail rests on one thin crowd-sourced data point (about EUR 10), and wine is inferred from the beer relationship. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation search was run and no live listings were checked. EUR to USD conversion used an assumed rate of about 1.15, which was not searched. The RBA rate came from search-result snippets of rba.gov.au pages, not a full page read, so the as-of date should be confirmed against the official F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized, tourism-active Spanish city in the Basque Country, benchmarked against general Spanish mid-sized city price levels and Bilbao-specific aggregator data. Menu del dia lunch pricing is treated as the inexpensive-meal reference.
